messages.snippet: All, Delighted to confirm the Series C completed today. £55m subscribed, 12,309,524 Series C shares
messages.subject: Project Slate - COMPLETED
messages.plaintextBody:
All,

Delighted to confirm the Series C completed today. £55m subscribed, 12,309,524 Series C shares issued at £4.4681. Executed subscription agreement attached for your records. We'll file SH01 and the special resolution at Companies House within the deadlines and send share certificates shortly.

Congratulations to everyone.

Elena

Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
